syslog_enable.description: Enable Finit’s internal syslog helper for kernel and service logging.

console_device.description: Console device to use for kernel/service output (e.g., /dev/console, /dev/ttyS0). Leave empty for kernel default.

hostname.description: System hostname to set at boot (overrides kernel command line).

runlevel_default.description: Default runlevel to jump to after bootstrap (runlevel S).

runlevels.description: Runlevels and services to activate per runlevel. Each entry defines a runlevel number and an ordered list of service names.

services.description: List of system services to manage. Each service defines name, command, and optional lifecycle behavior.
